content.title: Value Ladder | Raw Material to Human Payoff
content.summary: Establish value with a recognizable raw material, then increase completion through visible transformation, forming, and precise assembly. Finish by placing the completed object in a real user's hands so the industrial process resolves in a clear human payoff.

quick_start.input_format: recognizable raw material + controlled directional handoff + visible material transformation + repeated-unit forming and assembly + real-use payoff + finished-object lockup
quick_start.recommended_input: A rough translucent salt crystal rests on dark sandstone before a shallow harvesting bed of crystals becomes visible around it. Polished mineral becomes clear optical resin, and one viscous stream fills a sequence of hexagonal prism molds. An adult desert meteorologist raises the finished weather viewer; only its eyepiece reveals a crisp rainbow storm map. Hold, then cut to the closed brass instrument resting on sandstone.
required_anchors: Establish one recognizable raw material in isolation and then in sufficient quantity before any processing machinery appears.
Move that material into controlled processing through one visible directional handoff.
Convert the transformed material into repeated finished units through measured formation and orderly placement.
Resolve with a real user receiving, using or sharing the completed object, then hold a restrained final lockup.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish value with a recognizable raw material, then increase completion through visible transformation, forming, and precise assembly. Finish by placing the completed object in a real user's hands so the industrial process resolves in a clear human payoff.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Build a visible value ladder from one recognizable raw material through controlled intake, state transformation, precise unit formation and orderly final assembly. Each phase must preserve a causal trace of the same material while changing the camera duty to prove the new production state. End with a human use, exchange or sensory payoff that answers why the process was shown, followed by a brief finished-object lockup. The mechanism is process-to-human-value closure, not a particular food, brand or luxury package.

invariants.rule: Establish one recognizable raw material in isolation and then in sufficient quantity before any processing machinery appears.
invariants.ablation_failure: Beginning on machinery makes the input identity and later transformation ambiguous.

invariants.rule: Move that material into controlled processing through one visible directional handoff.
invariants.purpose: Proves that the later product comes from the established input.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated factory cut breaks material causality.

invariants.rule: Show one unmistakable material-state transformation at a scale where texture and behavior are readable.
invariants.purpose: Provides the central proof of added value.
invariants.ablation_failure: Skipping the state change turns the sequence into disconnected product shots.

invariants.rule: Convert the transformed material into repeated finished units through measured formation and orderly placement.
invariants.ablation_failure: A single unexplained final object cannot prove controlled manufacture.

invariants.rule: Resolve with a real user receiving, using or sharing the completed object, then hold a restrained final lockup.
invariants.purpose: Connects technical process to human consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending inside the factory leaves the value claim emotionally unfinished.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source cocoa pod seed, cocoa-bean field, bean hopper and chocolate-production machinery
the source melted-chocolate waves, droplets, filling stream and gold confection cavities
the source robotic chocolate gripper, brown luxury gift box and gold-wrapped pieces
the source adult-and-child tasting sequence, domestic beige wardrobe and exact sharing gestures
the source warm brown-and-gold palette, product framing and persistent Wavespeed Seedance 2.5 watermark
